description: Defines a templated FrameType class with nested Allocator, Reader, and Writer classes for handling binary data buffers, including serialization/deserialization methods, buffer management, and variable-length number encoding. Contains utility functions and template specializations for endianess and size handling.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class for managing binary data frames with buffer allocation, serialization, and deserialization capabilities, supporting different block sizes, endianess, and size contexts.

classes.name: FrameType::Reader
classes.description: A nested class providing methods to read data from a FrameType buffer, including variable-length number decoding, buffer access, and type-specific getters.

classes.name: FrameType::Writer
classes.description: A nested class providing methods to write data into a FrameType buffer, including variable-length number encoding, buffer setting, and type-specific setters.

classes.name: FrameType::AllocatorType
classes.description: A nested template class managing dynamic buffer allocation, reallocation, and memory management for the FrameType buffer.

methods.name: buffer_length_cast
methods.description: Utility template function to cast buffer length between types with safety checks.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a buffer of data into the frame at a specified offset.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Deserializes data from the frame buffer into a provided buffer.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Serializes a numeric value into the buffer with variable-length encoding.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Deserializes a numeric value from the buffer with variable-length decoding.

methods.name: SetVariableNumber
methods.description: Encodes a variable-length number into the buffer.

methods.name: GetVariableNumber
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length number from the buffer.

methods.name: SetText
methods.description: Serializes a string as text into the buffer.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Deserializes a string from the buffer.

methods.name: SetNullTerminatedText
methods.description: Serializes a null-terminated string into the buffer.

methods.name: GetNullTerminatedText
methods.description: Deserializes a null-terminated string from the buffer.

methods.name: SetBoolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value into the buffer.

methods.name: GetBoolean
methods.description: Deserializes a boolean value from the buffer.
